metadata.missing_values: Linear interpolation was applied to missing continuous physiological values before geographic records were extracted.
metadata.image_mapping: Street images use repository-relative paths in the form extracted_frames/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.jpg.
metadata.missing_image_behavior: The HTML displays a no-corresponding-image message when the image property is empty or the referenced file cannot be loaded.
metadata.browser_path_note: The HTML and GeoJSON must be served from the shenzhen_demo directory or from a parent web root that preserves the shenzhen_demo/video/extracted_frames path.
metadata.cache_behavior: The fixed HTML uses cache:no-store and cache-busting query parameters.
metadata.spectrogram_mapping: Spectrograms use repository-relative paths in the form spectrogram/YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS.jpg.
metadata.publication_note: Prepared as a static GitHub Pages demonstration.
